# GIF placeholders for README

This directory is used to hold GIFs referenced by the README. Add the following files to display animated demos in README.md:

- demo.gif — main demo shown at the top of README
- tech-stack-carousel.gif — recording of the tech stack carousel
- glassmorphism-carousel.gif — recording of the glassmorphism carousel

To add a GIF, record the sandbox UI (e.g. with a screen recorder), export a GIF, and place it here.
